messages:
Ravi: Drafting a pricing page experiment that ties into next week's webinar. Goals: cleaner FAQ with benchmark narrative, calculator that surfaces cost savings (batching/quant), and clear routing for webinar signups vs AE leads. Need quick takes on UTM->lead routing and CTA language.

Sofia: Nice. We should capture utm_source=webinar and utm_campaign=pricing_play in the lead payload so we can prioritize followups for attendees.

Ben: For calculator UX idea: show two numbers side-by-side: "Baseline (no batching)" vs "Optimized (batching + quant)" with percent savings. Short copy under the numbers explaining assumptions. That will feed into messaging in the webinar.

Lina: Tier names suggestion that avoid "Pro": Launch / Optimize / Scale / Enterprise Cloud. Each should have a one-line descriptor: Launch = dev-friendly hosted, Optimize = cost-savvy hosted + caching, Scale = dedicated capacity, Enterprise Cloud = private + SLA.

Ravi: Love the side-by-side calc. Also want a tiny toggle: include quantization? yes/no with tooltip: "quant reduces GPU memory & cost; may slightly alter logits for rare tokens". That tooltip will link to benchmark thread we cite in the FAQ.

Sofia: Routing rules proposal:
- If calc result >= $2k or selects "Scale"/"Enterprise Cloud" -> create AE lead, tag with utm params and webinar_interest=true if they came from webinar landing.
- If user checks "book a demo" checkbox -> immediately create calendar draft and flag AE_high_priority.
- Otherwise -> create marketing lead and trigger 7-day nurture sequence.

Ben: Analytics events to capture: pricing_calc_open, pricing_calc_toggle_quant, pricing_calc_toggle_batch, pricing_calc_run, pricing_calc_compare_view, pricing_calc_cta_click, pricing_lead_created, pricing_utm. We'll map those to the webinar cohort in GA and Amplitude.

Lina: FAQ edits: add "How do batching and quantization change my bill?" with a mini table + link to the benchmark doc. Add "Will I lose accuracy if I quantize?" short answer + gradient example (rare token difference). And add a quick graph: tokens/sec vs latency for each deployment type.

Ravi: CTA copy variants (new):
- "Calculate your expected bill"
- "See optimized price with batching"
- "Compare cost scenarios"
We'll A/B and let CTA be contextual: webinar traffic -> "See optimized price with batching"; organic docs -> "Calculate your expected bill".

Sofia: Also capture email + company size on calc CTA for self-serve. If UTM indicates webinar, pre-check "notify me about webinar" box.

OpsBot: scheduled reminder -> "Staging build for pricing page experiment deployed @ /staging/pricing-webinar. Run smoke tests: calc snapshot, utm capture, lead routing. Report results to #marketing by EOD Wed." :gear:

Ben: For the benchmark narrative in the FAQ and webinar: include a short blurb about how we measured throughput and cost (models, seq len, batching settings), and call out reproducible steps + links to the repo where we run the benchmarks. Keep it non-technical in FAQ and link to the detailed benchmark for curious readers.

Lina: We should add a microcopy line under tier names: "Not sure? Use the calculator or join our webinar for a walkthrough" with link to the webinar registration. That should help routing.

Ravi: Timeline: staging push today, smoke test tomorrow, soft-launch on Thu to 10% traffic with webinar UTM pinned. Full roll after 72h if metrics look good (calc_cta_ctr, lead_rate, webinar signups).

Sofia: I'll prepare the nurture email sequence and the webinar follow-up copy. Ben, can you set up the Amplitude funnel for the calc variants and tieutm->cohort?

Ben: On it. Will share dashboard link here when ready.

Ravi: Thanks team. I'll post the playbook doc and the gating checklist. Will also add a sample lead JSON payload we want ops to ingest.
